mods.aiSummary: Adds a transhumanist megacorporation faction with custom ships, weapons, and aggressive playstyles.

mods.name: Vram Optimizer
mods.summary: A memory optimization mod that converts vanilla and modded textures into the DirectDraw Surface (DDS) format with BC7 compression.
mods.aiSummary: Converts vanilla and modded textures into DDS format with BC7 compression to reduce VRAM usage.

mods.name: What May Be Safely Written: The Eldest 0.1 (Conceptual WIP, LF Coder, Artist)

mods.aiSummary: Adds cosmic horror elements, including new factions and entities like Phage and Gatekeepers.

mods.name: What We Left Behind
mods.summary: This mod focuses on exploration and colony content, with a particular incline towards cosmic horror and esoteric nonsense. Various terrifying secrets exist in the reaches of the sector, waiting for you to discover them.
mods.aiSummary: Adds exploration and colony content featuring cosmic horror themes, new terrain types, defense satellites, and interconnected world reactions.

mods.name: WhichMod

mods.name: WhichTMI
mods.summary: WhichTMI adds subtext with exact numerical info for some weapon stats that are otherwise hidden from the player one way or another. This mod does not add anything fancy and is only intended to be used as a companion to TMI, or as a lightweight variation on it.
mods.aiSummary: Adds subtext with exact numerical info for some weapon stats that are otherwise hidden from the player.

mods.name: Whisper's Techmining Alterations

mods.summary: Co-op multiplayer for Starsector battles. One player hosts a battle (a mission, the simulator or a campaign fight) and up to three friends(default, goes up to 16 but why would you do that?) join it, each flying a ship from the host's fleet, side by side, in real time.
mods.aiSummary: Adds co-op multiplayer for combat battles, letting up to three friends join a host's fight in real time.

mods.name: WIP Aardwolf & Zenith: ARRUS Hullmods

mods.name: Worldsmith Console Commands 1.1.1
mods.summary: (Starsector 0.98a-RC8): reshape the sector from the console. Create planets, stars (might still be a little buggy) and whole star systems, terraform instantly, found new factions (yes this works, you can also custamize them a lot, check the readme or github description), start total war or plunge the sector into an apocalypse. Needs Console Commands, LazyLib and Nexerelin; can be added mid-save, not removed. Most Information on GitHub or the Readme https://github.com/tofife999-glitch/WorldsmithConsoleCommands/releases/latest Extra: Much of the code (95%) is AI written. My involvement in the code was mostly early on and then some bug fixing, I have tested every command in multiple ways multiple times and they all worked for me, but there might still be bugs. should also run on java 27, with the updated mikohime and fr.
